text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference.  One original fictional adult man age 25. East Asian man with messy warm blond short hair, light playful confident charm, fitted charcoal tee and tiny silver ear stud. Facial design: square-oval face, strong cheek width, softly curved brows, rounded slightly wide-set brown eyes, broad short nose with subtle tip definition, small cupid-bow mouth, medium warm complexion. Fitted charcoal short-sleeve tee, black straight trousers, black leather ankle boots, tiny silver ear stud. Athletic 186cm build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 8.5-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text. Tall lean athletic male fashion-model anatomy with approximately 8.5 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head excluding hair volume is about 11.8% of total standing height. Long legs and arms, proportionate shoulders and waist, normal neck length, natural muscle definition. Do not elongate the face or neck or use shoe soles to fake height. Straight camera with no foreshortening.
